title: UIPilotTestcaseUserInput
description: Raw user-input shape for UIPilot testcases. The top-level value is either a UIPilotTestcaseUserInputList object (with ParallelDegree + UIPilotTestcaseConfigs) or a bare UIPilotTestcaseUserInput[] array. The converter rewrites every Parameters[*].User alias into a UPN (alias@tenantName) before writing the per-group job-input config.

then.description: Bare array form: a list of UIPilotTestcaseUserInput entries with no group-level ParallelDegree.

UIPilotTestcaseUserInputList.description: Top-level group of testcases plus the group-level ParallelDegree.

ParallelDegree.description: Max number of in-flight testcases sharing any one LockResourceKey. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

UIPilotTestcaseUserInput.description: A single UIPilot testcase. TestcaseId becomes the entity id.

TestcaseId.description: Unique testcase id (becomes the entity id).

IsHeadless.description: Whether the testcase should be dispatched headless. Persisted; queue routing is a follow-up PR.

ReferencedTestCaseId.description: Prerequisite testcase id that must SUCCEED before this one runs. Null means no dependency; otherwise set to another entry's TestcaseId to enforce ordering.

LockResourceKeys.description: Lock-resource keys this testcase holds while running. At most ParallelDegree in-flight testcases may share any one key (typically the meeting participant aliases).

items.description: A single lock-resource key (e.g. a participant alias).

Parameters.description: Per-step parameters (pass-through to the executor; aliases resolved to UPN in conversion).

UIPilotTestcaseUserInputParameter.description: One Task performed by one User, carrying one or more Assignments. The converter rewrites User from alias to UPN; it does NOT resolve ReferencedType / ReferencedId / ReferencedProperty — the executor does that at run time.

Task.description: The task name (the operation this parameter drives).

User.description: The actor — alias before ConvertJobInput, UPN after. One task is performed by one user.

Assignments.description: One entry per parameter name produced for this task. Empty array when the task takes no parameters.

UIPilotTestcaseUserInputAssignment.description: A single parameter-name slot. Either a literal value (ParameterValue) or a (ReferencedType, ReferencedId, ReferencedProperty) triple resolved against a trace row at run time.

ParameterValue.description: Literal value when the assignment is not a reference. Mutually exclusive with the Referenced* triple.

ReferencedType.description: Referenced entity type when this assignment is resolved from another trace (e.g. 'Event').

ReferencedId.description: Referenced entity id (e.g. the event id to read from).

ReferencedProperty.description: Referenced entity property name to read (e.g. 'JoinWebUrl').

oneOf.description: Literal-value assignment: ParameterValue is set and the Referenced* triple is absent/null.
Reference-triple assignment: all three Referenced* fields are set and ParameterValue is absent/null.
